name: ovira-panel
description: Self-hosted multi-protocol VPN management panel with multi-node, outbound routing, resellers, and subscription pages

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,lime "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
